label: Figure 16.3: New classical view - impact of an increase in AD (long run, price only)
alt: A vertical LRAS at Yf with AD shifting right from AD1 to AD2. The price level rises from P1 to P2 while output stays at Yf.
caption: AD shifts right from AD<sub>1</sub> to AD<sub>2</sub> (purple arrows). Because LRAS is vertical, the whole effect in the long run falls on the price level, which rises from P<sub>1</sub> to P<sub>2</sub>, while real output remains at Y<sub>f</sub>.
